name: Rotterdam Marathon
description: The Rotterdam Marathon is known for its fast and flat course through the heart of Rotterdam. With enthusiastic crowds lining the streets, it's one of the fastest marathons in the world.

cityInfo.transportInfo: Rotterdam has excellent public transport with metro, tram, and bus services. The RET Day Ticket is a good option for marathon day when moving between viewing spots.

viewingLocations.name: Coolsingel - Start
viewingLocations.description: The starting area of the marathon near Rotterdam City Hall

viewingLocations.name: Erasmus Bridge
viewingLocations.description: Iconic bridge with good viewing spots

viewingLocations.description: Along the waterfront with excellent views

viewingLocations.name: Half Marathon Point
viewingLocations.description: The halfway point near Nesselande area

viewingLocations.name: Churchillplein
viewingLocations.description: Central location with easy access to refreshments

viewingLocations.name: Blaak
viewingLocations.description: You can see the runners approach the final stretch

spectatorTips: Arrive at viewing spots at least 20 minutes before your runner is expected
Use a bike to navigate between viewing spots - Rotterdam is very bike-friendly
Consider purchasing a RET day ticket for public transport
The finish area gets extremely crowded - secure your spot early
Good spots to see your runner multiple times: Coolsingel (start and finish) and areas around Blaak
Download the official marathon app for real-time tracking
